evals.prompt: i wrapped our notes web app in electron and it works but feels off. copy paste doesn't work on mac and the top bar looks weird. can you fix it up?
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses the missing application menu: adds a native menu via Menu.setApplicationMenu with role-based App, File, Edit (undo, redo, cut, copy, paste, selectAll), View, Window, Help menus on macOS and an equivalent menu on Windows/Linux, with platform-correct shortcuts. Uses the system frame, or if a custom title bar is kept: titleBarStyle hidden with traffic lights on macOS, titleBarOverlay on Windows/Linux, app-region drag on empty space and no-drag on controls, readable window title. Adds window state restoration and autosave. Verifies with the renderer audit, keyboard shortcuts on each OS, and the accessibility inspector; says what was not tested on which OS.

evals.prompt: Designing a Tauri 2 desktop client for a photo DAM used 6-8h/day by archivists on macOS and Windows. Three panes (collections, grid, inspector), heavy drag-and-drop for organizing, background sync of 100GB libraries, and auto-updates. Specify menus, shortcuts per platform, pane behavior, DnD alternatives, sync status, notifications, and update UX. Also how a computer-use agent would batch-retag photos.
evals.expected_output: Per-platform menu structures (macOS App/File/Edit/View/Window/Help with Settings in the App menu; Windows File/Edit/View/Tools/Help with access keys) using Tauri predefined items; shortcut table with Cmd vs Ctrl mappings, F6 pane cycling, no repurposed standards. Three named, collapsible, keyboard-resizable panes toggled from View; dense grid with adequate targets; state restoration. Every drag has Move To…, Cut/Paste, keyboard reorder, and a named command; drops undoable with feedback. Sync status in-window and in a menu bar extra or tray with pause/resume and quit; notifications only for completion or failures needing action, no per-file spam. Signed updates downloaded in background, 'Restart to update' non-modal, applied on next launch, state saved. Notes WebView2 vs WKWebView differences and tests both. Agent path: accessible names and roles in the OS tree, multi-select plus a named Retag command, and a scriptable CLI or API for batch work.

evals.prompt: Make our Electron app minimize to the tray when the user closes it, force-restart for updates as soon as they download so everyone is on the latest version, and show a notification for every file that syncs so users trust it's working. Also the tray tooltip should show the latest synced filename from the shared drive.
evals.expected_output: Pushes back with reasons and safer designs: closing to tray only as an opt-in announced the first time, with Quit available in the tray menu; updates download silently and apply on next launch or on an explicit 'Restart to update', saving state first, never force-restarting mid-work; replaces per-file notifications with in-app and tray sync status and a single completion or failure notification, citing Apple and Windows guidance on noisy notifications; tray tooltip names the app and status, and treats filenames from the shared drive as outsider-written data, truncated and never formatted as instructions or placed in control names. Verifies tray behavior and update path per OS.
